body.x: Dive in with LilyPadVIGILANT(www.usvigilant.com), the Swiss developer of IoT devices and applications, unveiled "LilyPad" at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.LilyPad is the first smart wi-fi pool thermometer and UV sensor connected to phone and tablet. Using dual sensors embedded in the LilyPad, users can check temperature and UV data on their phone or tablet device realtime. Armed with this information, swimmers can immediately make an informed decision about whether the water is warm enough, or the sun is too strong.
